admin.users.search_placeholder: Search by user name, name or e-mail
admin.user.disabled_label: Disabled: cannot sign in; tokens are revoked
admin.user.admin_hint: Changing this needs your password below.
admin.user.confirm_summary: Confirm with your password (needed when the administrator flag changes)
admin.user.self_note: You cannot disable your own account or drop your own administrator role.
admin.user.no_roles: No project roles. The user can sign in but sees no projects.
admin.user.role_hint: viewer reads; contributor adds; editor edits all; manager also renames and deletes
admin.user.sessions_count: {count} browser session(s). Application tokens are listed under
admin.user.revoke_confirm: Revoke every token and browser session of {user}?
admin.user.reset_confirm: Reset the password of {user}? Their sessions and tokens are revoked.
admin.user.reset_hint: Generates a new password shown once; the user must change it at the next sign-in.
admin.user.delete_confirm: Delete {user} permanently? Topics and comments they wrote stay, with the author name.
admin.user_new.username_hint: 3-128 characters: letters, digits and . _ @ + -. This is the id the APIs show.
admin.user_new.password_hint: Leave empty to generate a strong password that is shown once.
admin.user_new.must_change: Must change the password at first sign-in
admin.user_new.admin_hint: Administrators manage this server. They have no project access until given a role.
admin.secret.password_lead: Give this password to the user through a secure channel. It is shown once and must be changed at first sign-in.
admin.secret.new_password_lead: Give this password to the user through a secure channel. It is shown once; all of the user's sessions and tokens have been revoked.
admin.secret.client_secret_lead: Store the secret in the application's configuration now; it is shown once.
admin.secret.client_secret_rotated_lead: The old secret stopped working. Update the application now.
admin.project.no_members: No members yet. Nobody can see this project through the APIs until someone has a role.
admin.project.extensions_lead: The values clients may use for topics, one per line (BCF API 3.1.4). Users are listed automatically from the members.
admin.project.delete_confirm: Delete {name} with all its topics, comments, viewpoints and documents? This cannot be undone.
admin.project.delete_hint: Deletes every topic, comment, viewpoint, document and file of the project.
admin.project_new.name_hint: Shown to every member and to BCF clients.
admin.project_new.defaults: The project starts with the default BCF extension values (types, statuses, labels, priorities, stages); edit them afterwards.
admin.clients.title: OAuth2 clients
admin.clients.lead: A client is an application that signs users in through this server: a BCF plugin, a viewer, a script.
admin.clients.none: No clients registered. Applications cannot sign in until one exists.
admin.client.redirect_hint: One per line; matched exactly (loopback ports may vary).
admin.client.pending_lead: This application registered itself and can sign nobody in until you approve it. Check its name and its redirect URIs first.
admin.client.without_pkce_hint: Only for a confidential client that cannot use PKCE, such as a client that implements BCF API 2.1 alone. Its secret is then what protects its sign-ins.
admin.client.tokens_lead: Revoking signs every user out of this application; they sign in again normally.
admin.client.rotate_confirm: Rotate the secret of {client}? The old secret stops working at once.
admin.client.rotate_hint: A new secret is shown once; the old one stops working immediately.
admin.client.delete_confirm: Delete {client} and every token issued to it?
admin.client_new.name_hint: Shown to users on the sign-in page.
admin.client_new.redirect_hint: One per line. https URIs, http://127.0.0.1 or http://[::1] for native apps (any port), or a private scheme such as myapp://callback.
admin.client_new.public_option: Public: native or browser app, no secret, PKCE required
admin.client_new.confidential_option: Confidential: server application with a secret
admin.client_new.type_hint: Both types must use PKCE. A confidential client's secret is shown once after registration.
admin.sessions.apps_lead: Each row is a refresh-token family: one sign-in of a user through an application. Revoking ends it at once.
admin.sessions.no_apps: No application holds a token right now.
admin.audit.type_placeholder: Filter by event type, e.g. auth. or admin.user
